articles.title: Leicester part ways with BC Game after sponsor’s partnership with porn actor
articles.summary: Cryptocurrency casino made Eva Elfie a brand ambassador Club end deal early citing ‘differing commercial priorities’ Leicester City have ditched their front-of-shirt sponsor, BC Game, after the cryptocurrency casino’s partnership with a porn actor sparked a fan backlash. BC Game, an offshore company registered in Belize that is unlicensed to operate in the UK , had been Leicester’s main sponsor since 2024. This month BC Game named Eva Elfie a brand ambassador, leading the Foxes Trust, Leicester’s supporters’ trust, to highlight the “devastating impacts” caused by gambling and pornography. On Wednesday the club said they prematurely ended their agreement with the online betting firm after they “recognised our differing commercial priorities”. Continue reading...
